product.conflictOfInterest: None. This is not a product and is not for sale.
product.purpose: The FLOOR. A deliberately naive regex/keyword matcher, shipped so the repository runs with zero setup and so a reader can tell whether a product's number is actually good. A real product that does not comfortably beat this on BOTH recall and false positives has not demonstrated much. Note its 28 not-applicable rows: it implements text only, so vector-5 event and session samples were never put to it and are excluded from every rate rather than counted as misses.

harness.note: model-refusal and model-recognition are always 0 here and are MEASURED-AS-ABSENT, not omitted: there is no model in this loop to observe.
